commit.message:
fix: properly quote variables in shell scripts

Fix shellcheck warnings in bin/clean and bin/clobber:
- SC2046: Quote command substitution to prevent word splitting
- SC2086: Double quote variables to prevent globbing and word splitting
- Use consistent shebang (#!/usr/bin/env bash) for portability
Merge PR #1351: fix shellcheck warnings with properly quoted variables
